title: Fashion Show
content: I was in what appeared to be a fashion department/workshop which seemed like it was located below the mall or just a lower level, there were many people getting ready for a fashion show. Everyone was busy with a task, there were people creating designs, sewing bizarre outfits and from where I was there was an interview taking place. We were at a table and the interviewer was questioning what appeared to be either the models or the people managing the whole thing, there was one person being interviewed that stood out in particular. He was well dressed and wore a black and white striped suit along with a bowtie, he had a masculine presence but the strangest thing was… he had no head, instead of where his head should be there was a clothes hanger in which he ends up resting it on his human like hand. He was disappointed with what the the interviewer was asking him/ or he might’ve been just stressed. Then along came the fashion show, the most bizarre outfits came out with individuals waking up and down the catwalk. Different varieties of colours and materials, fluffy materials stood out. As I watching this all unfold, what caught my attention was the song in the background, it sounded a legit authentic but very cliche pop song reminiscent of the early 2000s. I remember how the song went and it’s lyrics since it was very repetitive, but upon waking the song was still stuck in my head. This is a song that I’ve never heard before and does not exist in waking life which is strange. The fashion show itself was interesting too.
